01 / INTRODUCTION

About Asher Void

(the) Asher Void is an evolving comedic experiment—an expanding ecosystem of performance art, digital media and assorted technologies. Misdirection, props and non sequiturs are its methods. Utter absurdity is the result. Relax, these are just jokes.
